objective: Measure whether a frontier coding agent can retrieve and use evidence from a maintained wiki, raw Markdown, or an MCP-backed index as corpus size and ambiguity increase.

required_controls: same page content and identifiers across every arm
same corpus snapshot and update timestamp
same question set stratified by wiki and cross-wiki scope
same model, prompt budget, tool budget, and temperature
recommended_sources: Wikipedia Good Articles / Wiki Live Challenge where licensing and snapshot terms permit
a Karpathy-style interlinked Markdown wiki compiled from the same source pages
a synthetic enterprise wiki with exact identifiers, aliases, stale facts, and NIL questions

arms.backend: Karpathy-style index plus interlinked Markdown pages
entity/link expansion plus bounded page retrieval

arms.interface: one tool per wiki plus router

arms.backend: all pages in context where token budget permits

analysis.primary: paired per-question comparison with corpus size and arm fixed effects
analysis.saturation_rule: report the first size at which Recall@5, answer correctness, or p95 latency crosses a pre-registered degradation threshold; never infer saturation from raw top-k alone
required_ablation: MCP boundary overhead with identical backend
single federated tool versus one tool per wiki
analysis.promotion_gate: Do not ship an agentic-RAG default until it improves answer correctness and evidence citation at a fixed latency/cost budget on held-out questions, including NIL and cross-wiki cases.
